name: reviewops-auditor-benchmark
description: Normalize, validate, benchmark, and recommend from declared local review-run evidence offline.

interface.longDescription: Read explicitly declared sanitized local exports, protocols, labels, and pricing snapshots; normalize runs, audit evaluation validity, score fair comparison lanes, and emit shadow-only reference-architecture guidance. Optional static diagnostics remain secondary. This release uses no network, credentials, writeback, or model replay.
defaultPrompt: Use $normalize-review-runs on the bundled synthetic fixture only. Explain the normalization summary, provenance checks, safety boundaries, and next safe step.
Use $audit-review-eval-validity on the bundled synthetic fixture only. Explain which comparison claim is supported, which controls are held constant, and what would block a recommendation.
Use $benchmark-review-configs on the bundled synthetic fixture only. Explain the eligible root-cause metrics, exclusions, confidence intervals, and risk slice limitations.
Use $recommend-review-reference-architecture on the bundled synthetic fixture only. Explain the claim boundary, preserved production contracts, human approval gate, and no-posting shadow next step.
